devotions.title: Made On Purpose
devotions.description: You were not an accident or a mistake. God made you on purpose, and He likes what He made.

devotions.title: When The Lights Go Out
devotions.description: Being scared is not a sin or a failure. The verse does not say if I am afraid, it says when.

devotions.title: The Weight You Put Down
devotions.description: Forgiving someone is not saying what they did was okay. It is choosing to stop making them pay for it.

devotions.title: Counting What You Already Have
devotions.description: Thankful people are not the ones with the most stuff. They are the ones who actually notice what they have.

devotions.title: The Empty Seat
devotions.description: God notices the person standing alone, and He wants us to walk over there.

devotions.title: Why, Not Just What
devotions.description: God cares about why you obey, not just whether you obey.

devotions.title: More Than A Good Teacher
devotions.description: Jesus is not just a kind man from history. He is God you can actually see.

devotions.title: Talking To Someone Who Is There
devotions.description: Prayer is not magic words. It is talking to a Father who is actually listening.

devotions.title: Can We Trust This Book
devotions.description: The Bible is not a book of made up stories. It is one long true story that has held up under hard questions for a very long time.

devotions.title: What To Do With The Fire
devotions.description: Anger is not always wrong, but it makes a terrible boss.

devotions.title: Where Your Eyes Go
devotions.description: What you keep looking at slowly becomes what you think about, and what you think about becomes who you are.

devotions.title: The Towel And The Basin
devotions.description: In God's family, the great ones are not the ones being waited on. They are the ones doing the serving.

devotions.title: Walking Before You See
devotions.description: Faith is trusting Someone enough to take the next step before you can see the whole staircase.

devotions.title: An Anchor In The Storm
devotions.description: Hope is being held by something steady while the waves are still moving.

devotions.title: Love That Costs Something
devotions.description: Love is something you do, not just something you feel or say.

devotions.title: The Slow Growing Things
devotions.description: The best things in life grow slowly, and being patient is trusting that the wait is doing something.

devotions.title: The City With No Walls
devotions.description: Self control is being strong enough to choose what you do instead of just reacting, and there is nothing boring about that kind of strength.

devotions.title: Nothing To Hide
devotions.description: Telling the truth keeps you free, because you never have to remember which story you told.

devotions.title: Open Hands
devotions.description: Generosity has less to do with how much you have than with how tightly you hold it.

devotions.title: The Lowest Seat
devotions.description: A humble person does not need to be noticed, which leaves them free to notice everyone else.

devotions.title: Brave Is Not Fearless
devotions.description: You can be afraid and still do the right thing, because God goes with you. That is what courage is.

devotions.title: Enough Right Here
devotions.description: Contentment is a thing you learn, not a thing you are born with.

devotions.title: The Friend Who Stays
devotions.description: A real friend is the one who is still there when things get hard, not just when things are fun.

devotions.title: Working For The Right Boss
devotions.description: How you do your work says something about you, even when nobody is watching.

devotions.title: Permission To Stop
devotions.description: God built rest into the week on purpose, because He made us to need it.

devotions.title: Taking Care Of The Garden
devotions.description: God gave us His world to look after, not to use up and throw away.

devotions.title: Not A Building
devotions.description: The church is people who belong to each other, long before it is a building you go to.

devotions.title: The Meal That Remembers
devotions.description: The bread and the cup are a way of remembering what Jesus gave for us.

devotions.title: Every Sad Thing Undone
devotions.description: Heaven is not floating on clouds. It is the day God makes everything that is broken right again.

devotions.title: What Love Was Willing To Do
devotions.description: The cross is where God showed exactly how far His love was willing to go.

devotions.title: The Stone Was Moved
devotions.description: Jesus did not stay dead, and that changes everything about what is possible.

devotions.title: God Who Lives Close
devotions.description: When Jesus went back to heaven, He did not leave us alone. He sent His Spirit to live with us.

devotions.title: What You Are Made Of
devotions.description: Worship is giving God the biggest place in your heart, and the singing is only one way that shows.

devotions.title: The Gift You Cannot Earn
devotions.description: Grace is getting something good you could never have earned, just because God is generous.

devotions.title: Turning Around
devotions.description: Repentance is turning around and going the other way, which asks more of you than feeling sorry.

devotions.title: Not Getting What You Deserve
devotions.description: Mercy is choosing kindness when someone has earned the opposite.

devotions.title: Whose Voice Gets Heard
devotions.description: God cares deeply about the people the world forgets, and He wants us to speak up for them.

devotions.title: The Hardest Love
devotions.description: Anyone can love the people who are nice to them. Jesus calls us to love even the people who are not.

devotions.title: Small But Powerful
devotions.description: Words are tiny, but they can build people up or burn them down.

devotions.title: The Thief Of Glad
devotions.description: Comparing yourself to others will steal your joy faster than almost anything.

devotions.title: The Right Kind Of Awe
devotions.description: Fearing God means taking Him seriously, with awe, the way you feel small and glad at the edge of the ocean.

devotions.title: More Than Being Smart
devotions.description: Being smart is knowing a lot. Being wise is knowing what to do with what you know.

devotions.title: When It Really Hurts
devotions.description: God does not waste our pain. He can bring good even out of the hard things.

devotions.title: Strength In The Waiting
devotions.description: Waiting on God is its own kind of work, gathering strength for what comes next.

devotions.title: He Keeps His Word
devotions.description: God's love does not run out, and His mercy is new every single morning.

devotions.title: Dressed For The Day
devotions.description: There is a real struggle between good and evil, and God gives us everything we need to stand strong.

devotions.title: What Grows On The Tree
devotions.description: Good character grows in you when the Spirit is at work, like fruit on a tree, and no one has ever forced a tree to bear.

devotions.title: Upside Down Happy
devotions.description: Jesus says the truly happy people are the opposite of who the world says they are.

devotions.title: The One Who Comes Looking
devotions.description: Jesus is a shepherd who leads us and would die to keep us safe, and a shepherd does not drive his sheep from behind.

devotions.title: The Father Who Runs
devotions.description: No matter how far you have run from God, He is already looking down the road for you.

devotions.title: Everyone You Meet
devotions.description: Every single person you meet carries the image of God, so every single person matters.

devotions.title: You Are Not Just A Keeper
devotions.description: God does not just want us to keep the good news to ourselves. He sends us out to share it.

devotions.title: When Someone Hurts You
devotions.description: Forgiving someone means you hand the debt to God instead of making them pay, and it never says that what they did was okay.

devotions.title: The Cure For A Grumpy Heart
devotions.description: Thankfulness is choosing to notice the good gifts God has already given, even on a day when plenty is wrong.

devotions.title: Talking With God
devotions.description: Prayer is talking with a Father who loves to hear you, with no magic words and no fancy speech required.

devotions.title: A Light For The Path
devotions.description: The Bible is how God talks to us. It is a light that shows us the way to go.

devotions.title: Trusting Enough To Obey
devotions.description: We obey God not to make him love us, but because we trust that he loves us and knows what is best.

devotions.title: Small Things With Great Love
devotions.description: Kindness is love you can see. It is noticing other people and doing the small good thing.

devotions.title: A Happiness That Holds
devotions.description: Joy is deeper than happy feelings. It is a settled gladness that comes from belonging to God, even on hard days.

devotions.title: When Your Heart Is Worried
devotions.description: Jesus gives a peace that does not wait for the problems to go away, because it rests on him and not on them.

devotions.title: Three And Yet One
devotions.description: There is one God who lives forever as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, three persons who have always loved each other.

devotions.title: God Called It Good
devotions.description: The world was spoken into being by a God who meant to make it and called it good.

devotions.title: How It All Went Wrong
devotions.description: The world is broken because people stopped trusting God and went their own way, and that same pull lives in all of us.

devotions.title: The God Who Keeps His Word
devotions.description: God always keeps his promises, every single one, no matter how long it takes.

devotions.title: God Came Close
devotions.description: God did not stay far away. He became one of us, with skin and a heartbeat, so we could know him.

devotions.title: A Glimpse Of The Mender
devotions.description: The miracles of Jesus were small previews of the day he makes everything broken whole again.

devotions.title: He Is Coming Back
devotions.description: Jesus came once as a baby to save us, and he is coming again as a King to set everything right.

devotions.title: Everything New Again
devotions.description: God is going to make the world new, the way it was always meant to be, rather than throw it away.

devotions.title: Strong Enough To Be Gentle
devotions.description: Gentleness is strength that chooses to be careful with people, and it takes more strength than shoving does.

devotions.title: Good All The Way Through
devotions.description: Goodness is choosing to do the right thing, again and again, even when no one notices and it would be easier not to.

devotions.title: Keep Going
devotions.description: Perseverance is keeping on, one step at a time, all the way to the end, when quitting would be easier.

devotions.title: Taking Care Of What Is Not Yours
devotions.description: Everything we have is really God's, given to us to take care of well, not to use up however we please.

devotions.label: The Friday before Thanksgiving
devotions.title: Where It All Came From
devotions.description: Moses said this to people who had eaten manna in the desert for forty years, one day's food at a time, and were about to sit down at full tables of their own.

devotions.label: The Saturday before
devotions.title: The One Who Came Back
devotions.description: Leprosy meant living apart from everyone, even your own family. These men could only call to Jesus from a distance.

devotions.label: The Sunday before
devotions.title: Thanks in the Middle of It
devotions.description: Paul wrote this to a young church that was suffering for following Jesus. He knew how hard things were for them.

devotions.label: Monday
devotions.title: The Year the Fig Tree Did Not Bud
devotions.description: Habakkuk wrote this knowing an army was coming, and the verse before says his whole body shook with fear.

devotions.label: Tuesday
devotions.title: The Guests Who Cannot Pay You Back
devotions.description: Most of us make guest lists the way Jesus describes: friends, family, people who will ask us back.

devotions.label: Wednesday
devotions.title: The Empty Chair
devotions.description: Tomorrow some of us will set the table with a chair missing. Maybe someone died this year, or long ago and it still hurts.

devotions.label: Thanksgiving Day
devotions.title: His Love Lasts Forever
devotions.description: Psalm 136 has twenty-six verses, and every one ends the same way: his loving devotion endures forever.

devotions.label: December 1
devotions.title: The Long Wait Begins
devotions.description: On the worst day in the story, when everything had already broken, God made a promise. Nothing about that afternoon got fixed, and the promise would take thousands of years to come true.

devotions.label: December 2
devotions.title: A Family for the World
devotions.description: Abram was old and had no children, and God told him his family would bless the whole world.

devotions.label: December 3
devotions.title: God Hears in the Dark
devotions.description: The people had been slaves for four hundred years. Four hundred years is longer than the United States has existed.

devotions.label: December 4
devotions.title: A King Who Lasts
devotions.description: David was a real king with a real throne, and God told him a son from his line would reign forever.

devotions.label: December 5
devotions.title: Out of Bethlehem
devotions.description: Bethlehem was a small town, the kind of place travelers passed through on the way to somewhere bigger.

devotions.label: December 6
devotions.title: A Child Is Given
devotions.description: Isaiah said these words seven hundred years before the first Christmas. He had never seen a manger.

devotions.label: December 7
devotions.title: A Light in Deep Darkness
devotions.description: Isaiah did not pretend the darkness was not real. He called it deep, he called it shadow, he did not soften it.

devotions.label: December 8
devotions.title: A Branch from a Stump
devotions.description: A stump is what is left after a tree gets cut down. It looks finished, dead, done. Israel had been cut down to a stump, the old royal family reduced to almost nothing.

devotions.label: December 9
devotions.title: Comfort My People
devotions.description: After many hard chapters, God says one word twice. Comfort, comfort. He is not embarrassed to comfort his people.

devotions.label: December 10
devotions.title: The Servant Who Carries It
devotions.description: This is the strangest promise of Advent. The one who is coming will not just rule, he will suffer.

devotions.label: December 11
devotions.title: A New Heart
devotions.description: Notice what God promised here. He could have promised us better rules, and we would have taken them.

devotions.label: December 12
devotions.title: How Long, O Lord
devotions.description: Even in Advent, full of promises, the people of God asked hard questions out loud. How long.

devotions.label: December 13
devotions.title: The Messenger Comes First
devotions.description: Malachi is the last book before a long silence. After he spoke, four hundred years passed with no prophet, no new word.

devotions.label: December 14
devotions.title: An Old Man Hears Good News
devotions.description: Zechariah and Elizabeth were old and had prayed for a child for years with no answer. They had probably stopped expecting one.

devotions.label: December 15
devotions.title: Let It Be
devotions.description: Mary was young, probably a teenager, and the angel asked her to carry the Son of God, which would turn her whole life upside down.

devotions.label: December 16
devotions.title: The Lowly Lifted
devotions.description: When Mary found out what God was doing, she did not sing a quiet little lullaby. She sang about a world turned upside down, where the proud get knocked off their thrones and the forgotten get a seat at the table.

devotions.label: December 17
devotions.title: Joseph Stays
devotions.description: Joseph could have walked away, and no one would have blamed him. Instead he stayed, took on a son who was not his by blood, and raised the Savior of the world in a carpenter shop.

devotions.label: December 18
devotions.title: The Word Was God
devotions.description: Before Bethlehem, before the manger, before there was a sky to hang stars in, Jesus already was.

devotions.label: December 19
devotions.title: The Word Moved In
devotions.description: God could have saved us from far away, with a wave of his hand. Instead he came and lived among us, in a real town, on a real street, with people who knew his face.

devotions.label: December 20
devotions.title: The Night Before
devotions.description: On the night before everything changed, a tired couple was walking a hard road because a faraway emperor wanted to count people for taxes.

devotions.label: December 21
devotions.title: No Room
devotions.description: The King of the universe was born in a place where animals ate, because no one had a room for him.

devotions.label: December 22
devotions.title: Good News for Shepherds
devotions.description: When God announced the most important birth in history, he sent the news past the palace and the temple to shepherds working the night shift in a field.

devotions.label: December 23
devotions.title: Mary Treasured It
devotions.description: After the shepherds left and the noise died down, Mary did not rush on to the next thing. She held it all quietly and turned it over in her heart.

devotions.label: December 24
devotions.title: A Light to Everyone
devotions.description: Simeon was old and had waited his whole life to see God keep his promise. When he finally held the baby Jesus, he said he could die in peace now.

devotions.label: December 25
devotions.title: He Is Here
devotions.description: Today. After Genesis and the garden, after Abraham and David, after Isaiah and the long silence, after Mary and Joseph and the road to Bethlehem, the word is today.

devotions.label: Palm Sunday
devotions.title: The Wrong Kind of King
devotions.description: The crowd wanted a king who would ride in on a war horse and throw out the Romans. Jesus came in on a young donkey, slow and humble, the way kings came when they came in peace.

devotions.label: Monday
devotions.title: Turning Over the Tables
devotions.description: The temple was supposed to be the one place where anyone could come close to God, and people had turned it into a marketplace where the poor got cheated.

devotions.label: Tuesday
devotions.title: The Greatest Command
devotions.description: People kept trying to trap Jesus with hard questions that week, hoping he would say something they could arrest him for.

devotions.label: Wednesday
devotions.title: A Friend Walks Away
devotions.description: Judas had walked with Jesus for three years. He had seen the miracles, eaten the meals, heard every word.

devotions.label: Maundy Thursday
devotions.title: Bread, Cup, and Basin
devotions.description: On his last night, Jesus took off his outer robe, knelt down, and washed the dirty feet of his friends, a job usually left to the lowest servant.

devotions.label: Good Friday
devotions.title: It Is Finished
devotions.description: This is the hardest day, and we should not rush past it. Jesus, who had done nothing wrong, was nailed to a cross and died.

devotions.label: Holy Saturday
devotions.title: The Day of Silence
devotions.description: Saturday is the day nobody talks about much. Jesus was in the tomb, and his friends did not know yet that Sunday was coming.

devotions.label: Easter Sunday
devotions.title: He Is Not Here
devotions.description: The women came to the tomb in the dark, expecting to care for a dead body. Instead they found the stone rolled away and the grave empty.

catechism.question: Who made you?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God made me.

catechism.question: Is there a God, and how can we know?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Yes, there is one true God, and he shows us who he is.

catechism.question: What is God?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God is the Spirit who never began and never ends.

catechism.question: Is God one, or is God three?
catechism.kidsAnswer: There is one God, the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

catechism.question: Did God create everything?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Yes, God made everything, and it was good.

catechism.question: How did God create human beings?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God made people, boys and girls, in his own image.

catechism.question: What does it mean to be made in God's image?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Being God's image means I was made to know him and show what he is like.

catechism.question: Why did God make you?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God made me to love him and to be happy in him forever.

catechism.question: Does God control all that happens?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Yes, God is in charge of everything that happens.

catechism.question: Is God good even when life is hard?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Yes, God is always good, even when things are hard.

catechism.question: What does God require of us?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God wants me to love him with all I am and to love other people.

catechism.question: How has God spoken to us?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God speaks to us in the Bible, his true Word.

catechism.question: What is the Bible mainly about?
catechism.kidsAnswer: The Bible is one big story about Jesus saving us.

catechism.question: How did sin come into the world?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Sin came when the first people disobeyed God.

catechism.question: What is sin?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Sin is when I do not love God and others the way I should.

catechism.question: Did everyone fall into sin?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Yes, everyone is born with sin in their heart.

catechism.question: What has sin done to us?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Sin breaks us and keeps us away from God.

catechism.question: What is God's law?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God's law shows us how to love him and other people.

catechism.question: What does the law require of us toward God?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God wants us to worship and love only him.

catechism.question: What does the law require of us toward others?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God wants us to be kind, honest, and fair to other people.

catechism.question: Can we keep God's law perfectly?
catechism.kidsAnswer: No, I cannot keep God's law perfectly on my own.

catechism.question: Then why did God give us the law?
catechism.kidsAnswer: The law shows me my sin and points me to Jesus.

catechism.question: What do our sins deserve?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Sin is serious, and it brings God's judgment.

catechism.question: Is there any hope for sinners like us?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Yes, God loves sinners and sent Jesus to save us.

catechism.question: Who is Jesus Christ?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Jesus is the Son of God who became a man to save us.

catechism.question: Why did the Son of God become a man?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Jesus became a man to take our place and save us.

catechism.question: How was Jesus born?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Jesus was born of Mary, with no sin of his own.

catechism.question: What kind of life did Jesus live?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Jesus lived a perfect life and never sinned.

catechism.question: Why did Jesus have to die?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Jesus died to take the punishment for our sin.

catechism.question: What happened on the cross?
catechism.kidsAnswer: On the cross Jesus paid for our sin completely.

catechism.question: Did Jesus stay dead?
catechism.kidsAnswer: No, Jesus rose from the dead and is alive.

catechism.question: Where is Jesus now?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Jesus is in heaven, ruling over everything and praying for us.

catechism.question: What does it mean that Jesus is Lord?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Jesus is Lord means Jesus is the King of everything.

catechism.question: How are we saved?
catechism.kidsAnswer: We are saved by trusting in Jesus, not by being good enough.

catechism.question: What is grace?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Grace is God's love that I do not have to earn.

catechism.question: What is faith?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Faith is trusting Jesus to save me.

catechism.question: What is repentance?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Repentance is being sorry for sin and turning back to God.

catechism.question: What is justification?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Justification means God sees me as forgiven because of Jesus.

catechism.question: Can anything separate us from God's love in Christ?
catechism.kidsAnswer: No, nothing can take God's love away from me.

catechism.question: What does Jesus give us besides forgiveness?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Jesus gives us forgiveness and a whole new life with God.

catechism.question: Who is the Holy Spirit?
catechism.kidsAnswer: The Holy Spirit is God living in those who belong to Jesus.

catechism.question: What is the new birth?
catechism.kidsAnswer: The new birth is when God gives me a new heart that loves him.

catechism.question: What does it mean to be adopted by God?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Adopted means God has made me his own child.

catechism.question: What is sanctification?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Sanctification is God slowly making me more like Jesus.

catechism.question: How does the Spirit change us?
catechism.kidsAnswer: The Spirit helps me love God and grow good fruit in my life.

catechism.question: What is the church?
catechism.kidsAnswer: The church is God's family who follow Jesus together.

catechism.question: What is baptism?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Baptism is a sign that I belong to Jesus.

catechism.question: What is the Lord's Supper?
catechism.kidsAnswer: The Lord's Supper helps us remember Jesus died for us.

catechism.question: Why and how should we pray?
catechism.kidsAnswer: We pray because God is our Father who loves to hear us.

catechism.question: What did Jesus teach us to pray?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Jesus taught us to pray, Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name.

catechism.question: Will Jesus return?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Yes, Jesus is coming back to make everything right.

catechism.question: What is our hope for the life to come?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Our hope is to live with God forever with no more crying or pain.

catechism.question: What is prayer?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Prayer is talking with God, who loves to hear us.

catechism.question: How did Jesus teach us to pray?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Jesus taught us the Lord's Prayer.

catechism.question: Why do we call God Father?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Because God has made us his children through Jesus.

catechism.question: What does God require of us?
catechism.kidsAnswer: To love God with everything, and to love others as ourselves.

catechism.question: What are the Ten Commandments?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God's ten good rules that teach us to love him and love others.

catechism.question: Can we keep God's law perfectly?
catechism.kidsAnswer: No, only Jesus kept it perfectly, for us.

catechism.question: What should we do when we sin?
catechism.kidsAnswer: We tell God we are sorry, and he forgives us because of Jesus.

catechism.question: Why do we gather with the church?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Because God makes us part of his family, the church.

catechism.question: What is baptism?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Baptism is a sign that we belong to God and are washed clean by Jesus.

catechism.question: What is the Lord's Supper?
catechism.kidsAnswer: It is the meal where we remember Jesus gave his body and blood for us.

catechism.question: How does the Holy Spirit change us?
catechism.kidsAnswer: The Holy Spirit lives in us and grows his good fruit in our lives.

catechism.question: Why did God make you?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God made me to know him, love him, and be happy in him forever.

catechism.question: If God is good, why is there suffering and evil?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God is good, and one day he will end all suffering for good.

catechism.question: Is the Bible really true?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Yes, the Bible is God speaking to us, and it is true.

catechism.question: How do we know God is real if we cannot see him?
catechism.kidsAnswer: We cannot see God, but he has shown us who he is in Jesus.

catechism.question: What about people who never heard about Jesus?
catechism.kidsAnswer: We do not know everything, but we know God is always fair and kind.

catechism.question: Is Jesus really the only way to God?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Yes, Jesus is the only way home to God, and the door is open to all.

catechism.question: What happens when we die?
catechism.kidsAnswer: When those who love Jesus die, they go to be with him.

catechism.question: Did God make dinosaurs, and how does science fit with the Bible?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Yes, God made everything, even dinosaurs, and science studies his world.

catechism.question: Why does God sometimes say no to our prayers?
catechism.kidsAnswer: God answers every prayer in the way that is best, even when it is no.

catechism.question: What about other religions?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Other people search for God, and we believe Jesus is the one God sent.

catechism.question: Will God ever stop loving me if I am bad?
catechism.kidsAnswer: No, God will never, ever stop loving you.

catechism.question: Why do bad things happen to good people?
catechism.kidsAnswer: Hard things happen in a broken world, and God is with us in them.

catechism.question: How can God be three and one at the same time?
catechism.kidsAnswer: There is one God who is the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
